patterns.note: Full-screen, immersive sections dominate the initial scroll, each featuring a large, detailed background image or video with minimal text overlay.

The initial hero section features a background image that parallaxes behind the fixed foreground text. Subsequent sections transition by sliding vertically, with each new full-screen section replacing the previous one as the user scrolls.
The navigation bar starts transparent with light text and icons, then transforms into a solid white bar with dark text and icons after scrolling past the initial immersive sections.
Section titles are presented in a large, bold, uppercase sans-serif font, often with a subtle outline or shadow for contrast against complex backgrounds.
A high-contrast black and white palette is used for UI elements and text, providing legibility against the rich, detailed, and often colorful background imagery of the immersive sections.

technique_notes: The site uses full-viewport sections that transition on scroll, creating an immersive, story-like progression. Each section's background image or video (leveraging the 'video-hero' tech hint) is a key visual element.

A parallax scrolling effect is applied to the hero background, where the image moves at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating depth. This effect is likely managed with a scroll-triggered animation library.

The navigation bar employs a scroll-triggered state change: it starts transparent and overlays the hero, then becomes sticky and adopts a solid background and contrasting text color once the user scrolls past the initial hero content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings (~4-5x body) for section titles, paired with a clean, legible sans-serif for body and navigation text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners for most elements and containers, with subtle rounding on interactive elements like buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy in the full-screen hero and section transitions, creating a sense of grandeur; balanced density in the content sections and footer.

standout: The site's distinctive design lies in its full-screen, immersive scroll-triggered section transitions, each featuring highly detailed, high-production-value background imagery that tells a visual story. This creates a highly engaging and cinematic user experience, moving beyond typical static sections.
